headline: SAFF stays at 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a fourteenth flat day, while Tokopedia scores near 4.9 and a cheap 'inspired by' Coco copy using the SAFFNCO name surfaces.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs yesterday and 6 Nov: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), Mykonos 4.26, HMNS 4.15; no product moved. Onix page not found today.
Marketplace ratings run far above Female Daily: ILIAD scores 4.9 from about 2,900 Tokopedia ratings (under 1% at 1–2 stars) vs 4.6 on Female Daily; Maleali 4.9 from about 1,550.
New fake/dupe risk: a third-party Tokopedia shop sells an 'inspired by' Coco copy under the SAFFNCO name at Rp95k, under half the official price.
Short wear time is the most repeated weak point: Omnia's community profile shows about 3 hours with intimate sillage, in line with earlier SAFF and ILIAD projection reports.
Stock and price gaps at retail: Watsons shows Solaris 30ml at Rp179.5k (18% off) but appears out of stock.

recommendations.text: Report the 'inspired by' SAFFNCO Coco listing to Tokopedia and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
After 11.11, use the strong marketplace scores (ILIAD and Maleali 4.9 on Tokopedia) in ads and ask happy buyers to review on Female Daily too, before Mykonos Soft Hour reaches stores on 15 Nov.
Align normal vs promo price messaging and stock across website, Tokopedia, Watsons and Zalora so constant markdowns and out-of-stock pages do not hurt trust.
Set clear longevity expectations per Extrait and Cloud Mist (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with Omnia, S.O.T.B, ILIAD and Annabel Lee.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
